instructions.run_date: run.py asks for COB in DD/MM/YYYY. COB must be yesterday or earlier in Europe/London.
instructions.history: lookback=max requests the longest accessible history through COB. Provider and account limits are recorded; missing data is never filled.
instructions.archive: A completed tests/data_dumps/YYYY-MM-DD archive is reused without API calls. Interrupted runs resume unfinished requests.
instructions.products: SPX index and IEF ETF where supported; existing FRED/ECB reference series retained.
instructions.options: Only IBKR requests options: yesterday COB selects current live snapshots; older COB selects historical bars only. Live capture dates remain separate from COB.

observations.instructions: Use an economic-series identifier or dataset key, not a stock ticker. Set unit and frequency accurately; the provider response is authoritative.
